summary: Join our comprehensive training on credit rating agencies. Learn how they influence the economy and gain insights to navigate financial landscapes effectively.
lede: Credit rating agencies assess default risk by examining an issuer’s business and financial profile. For finance and risk professionals working with debt markets or capital structures, this training covers how to evaluate credit profiles and anticipate rating implications. Learners practice calculating financial risk ratios, modeling probability of default and loss given default, and building shadow rating models, with additional work on ESG credit indicators and debt covenants.
audienceIntro: This comprehensive training is engineered for finance and risk professionals who interact with debt capital markets, manage corporate capital structures, or oversee regulatory compliance related to credit assessments.
modules: Credit Rating Agency Ecosystem and Regulatory Frameworks
Rating Agency Advisory and Debt Optimization
prerequisites: Participants must have a working knowledge of corporate finance, financial statement analysis, and basic debt capital markets terminology. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required for the shadow rating modeling exercises. No advanced programming or coding experience is necessary, as AI-assisted analytical tools will be accessed via user-friendly web interfaces.
